title: ChatHealthy SpecialtyMetaData (NUCC Runtime Copy)
description: Runtime representation of the specialty CodeSystem in MongoDB. Holds both the NUCC-authoritative records (is_supplemented=false, loaded from nucc.org) and the ChatHealthy supplement records (is_supplemented=true, loaded from the F-105 supplement file). Applies HL7 FHIR R5 CodeSystem-supplement pattern: base + supplement live in one CodeSystem, each record tagged for provenance. See NUCC_SpecialtyCodeDataDiscrepancyManagement.docx.

is_supplemented.description: True for supplement records; false for NUCC-authoritative records. Always required.
